dog.description_text:
Sidney is a shy, sweet girl who just needs a little time to feel comfortable. She gets along well with other cats and has been with us for quite a while, patiently waiting for the right home.

Sidney is currently in a foster home, where she’s making great progress! Her foster tells us she’s doing really well and has even started accepting some pets. It’s been wonderful to see her becoming more comfortable and trusting at her own pace. Sidney would do best with someone who understands that the best relationships sometimes take a little time to build.

If this cat is located at our Manhattan Adoption Center, head in to meet them and see if you are a match! We are a same-day adoption center, and an application does not put you on a list or hold an animal for you. If they are in Wantagh or in a foster home, please submit an online application and our team will reach out to further discuss the adoption process. Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped, and given their age-appropriate vaccines.
